title: T4 — Evidence
body:
# Evidence — T4 Kanban coach (retrospective, 2026-11-22)

## Claim

T4 delivered the coach loop's interruption row, its one coach card with one triage and one remedy from closed sets, per-signature escalation, the depth cap and a systemic-class `kata.open` start. The named tests exist at HEAD; this retrospective did not re-run them. Four findings remain open; v1-p6-4 refutes the gate's universal 'exactly one' and v1-p6-2 shows the opened kata is only a process run.

## Evidence

- **Project record:** the 2026-11-22 snapshot `/tmp/u7-snapshot/data/programme.json` row `01a1d039-0d33-7e7e-890e-b437b0c78db9` — key T4, `closed`, version 10, updated 2026-11-21T01:08:53Z, tranche 4, `measured_status: built`, `viability: rework`, expected outputs `project-brief` and `evidence`, closure output `closure-review`.
- **Schema:** `migrations/0057_coach.sql` creates `coach_interruption` (line 19) and `coach_remedy` (line 85).
- **Tests:** `crates/actions/tests/coach.rs` — `an_interruption_yields_one_coach_card_one_triage_and_one_remedy` (577), `a_repeat_signature_escalates_instead_of_a_second_card` (683), `a_failed_coach_run_never_opens_a_coach_card` (745), `a_systemic_class_opens_one_kata` (816), `a_transient_class_opens_no_kata` (864), `the_seeded_coach_process_yields_one_card_one_triage_and_one_remedy` (1131), `a_nested_coach_run_is_refused` (1343); `crates/actions/tests/process_catalogue.rs::the_shipped_catalogue_runs_a_process_end_to_end` (262); `crates/actions/tests/registry.rs::the_registry_is_exactly_the_declared_set` (665); `crates/store/tests/s07_seed.rs::the_catalogue_seed_imports_every_exported_row_and_is_idempotent` (18).
- **Action surface:** `coach.interrupt`, the gates `coach.ask` and `coach.escalation`, the policy kind `coach.window`, and the store functions `open_interruption_tx`, `insert_interruption_tx`, `record_triage_tx`, `insert_remedy_tx`, `mark_remedied_tx`, `mark_escalated_tx`, `is_coach_card_tx`, `count_interruptions_for_card_tx` and `set_kata_candidate_tx` in `crates/actions/src/coach.rs`.
- **Governance:** tranche 4 (`01a1e9e0-f4c0-727d-9afb-bb5b1e9783ce`) is `planned`, with `authorisation_review_id` null, `authorised_at` null and `baseline_ref` null; its exit criteria name T4 among the tranche's projects. T4 is closed while the tranche is unauthorised; the rework records that fact under the standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`.

## Verification

An independent reader can open the named test functions and run them against real Postgres 18 in the repository's harness. This retrospective confirmed the functions exist at HEAD and did not execute them; it asserts no test result. The compile/test verdict is the repository's GitHub-hosted `preflight.yml`; the local gate is `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1` (`docs/plans/03-DELIVERY.md`). The acceptance instrument is `acceptance/programme/T4.toml`.

## Links

- Issues: https://github.com/nonagenticai/conveyor/issues/75
- Specification: `docs/SPEC_V2.md` sections 6.2, 6.4 and section 12 (T4)
- Schema: `migrations/0057_coach.sql`
- Tests: `crates/actions/tests/coach.rs`, `process_catalogue.rs`, `registry.rs`; `crates/store/tests/s07_seed.rs`
- Tranche 4: `01a1e9e0-f4c0-727d-9afb-bb5b1e9783ce`
- Standing delegation: `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`

## Gap

- **v1-p6-2 (P1).** The systemic path stores a `kata.open` run id and nothing else: no kata record, instrument, threshold, measurement or adoption gate.
- **v1-p6-4 (P1).** The per-card cap and the live-run skip silently drop a fourth distinct signature; no card, no escalation.
- **v1-p6-5 (P1).** Only failed runs call `coach.interrupt`; the other section 6.2 input kinds have no producer.
- **v1-p6-6 (P2).** `cards.create` can create an orphan coach card with no interruption backing.
- No contemporaneous charter, Statement of Architecture Work, delivery contract or Phase-G review existed at the snapshot; this set is retrospective and does not attest contemporaneous intent.
